title: cmd_equal compares only apply_tick + kind — wrong command payloads pass the expected-stream check
detail: Expected streams assert exact payloads (e.g. "{1, pp.Cmd_Demolish_Pipe{pipe = 0}}", "lane = pp.LANE_EXPRESS", "pos = {10, 10}"), but cmd_equal ignores a/b/pipe/type_idx/pos/class/lane/weights. A wrong-argument command passes; cross-device equality cannot catch it (same mapping runs on every device), and only the two draw scenarios have blessed hash goldens. The header claim "the mappings produce the RIGHT commands" holds only for those two.
recommended_fix: Compare the full command payload (a, b, pipe, node, type_idx, pos, tier, class, lane, weights) in cmd_equal, or add a payload-aware variant for the expected-stream comparison.

title: right_click scenario's sel_pipe == 0 assertion is never checked
evidence:
+// 11. right_click — mouse: draw 0->1, right-click the pipe SELECTS it (the
+// W3/W5 transcription, wired through a minimal parity effect that mirrors
+// the app's effect_right_click) — no commands, sel_pipe == 0.
+	name = "input_parity_right_click",
+		switch sc.name {
+		case "input_parity_select":
+		case "input_parity_tier_cycle":
+		case "input_parity_class_cycle":
+		case "input_parity_cancel":
+		case "input_parity_pan":
detail: The scenario comment promises "no commands, sel_pipe == 0", but check_states has no input_parity_right_click case; the run is mouse-only (cross-device equality vacuous), has no golden, and its expected stream is just the Draw. A broken right-click effect (no select, wrong pipe) passes green — the W3/W5 transcription is unpinned despite Parity_Run capturing sel_pipe.
recommended_fix: Add an "input_parity_right_click" case to check_states asserting sel_pipe == 0 (and sel_node == -1) after the right-click press.
